title: When the Wind Blows Through the Years
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
The station lights were burning low
As evening drifted down the line
You waved goodbye and turned to go
I kept the words I couldn't find

That little bookstore on the corner
Has a different name today
But I remember rain on the awning
And all the dreams we made

[Pre-Chorus]
We took our separate roads
And let the seasons fly
Some memories never leave us
No matter how we try

[Chorus]
When the wind blows through the years
Down the street where you disappeared
All the words we never said
Are still somewhere in yesterday
And the wind blows over me
Through the dreams we used to keep
If our paths should cross again
I'll smile and say, hello, old friend

[Verse 2]
There's a photograph inside a drawer
With faded edges, soft and worn
We thought that summer would last forever
And every story would go on

Now the city shines with strangers
And the nights are full of light
But sometimes I still hear our footsteps
On the road we walked at night

[Pre-Chorus]
Not every ending means regret
Not every love must stay
Some people leave a little light
That time can't take away

[Chorus]
When the wind blows through the years
Down the street where you disappeared
All the words we never said
Are still somewhere in yesterday
And the wind blows over me
Through the dreams we used to keep
If our paths should cross again
I'll smile and say, hello, old friend

[Bridge]
If the years could hear my voice
I'd ask them to tell you this
Thank you for the ordinary days
You turned into a gift

[Final Chorus]
When the wind blows through the years
I can see our story clear
All the words we couldn't say
Have found their peace along the way
And the wind blows over me
Toward the life that's yet to be
May the road be kind to you
And may our younger dreams shine through

[Outro]
When the wind blows through the years
I still see your smile so clear
notes: English-language original nostalgic folk-pop ballad, target 2:50–3:20. Mature intimate expressive female alto, natural American English diction and phrasing. 90–94 BPM, warm acoustic guitar, articulated piano, restrained cello, gentle organic pulse. Distinct original melody with memorable lifting chorus; emotionally related to Chinese counterpart but NOT a direct melody copy. Bridge intimate, final chorus warm, clear ending. Sing only the English lyrics, never Mandarin. No spoken narration, synthetic pads, muddy mix, artist imitation, excessive reverb, or abrupt cutoff.
